title: Ridgeline Pro Credit Underwriting Standard — Deciding a Business Credit Application
content:
A Ridgeline Pro Credit application names one tier. It is approved only when the business meets every entry requirement of that tier — years in business at or above the tier's minimum, a business credit score at or above the tier's minimum and annual revenue at or above the tier's minimum — and, where the tier requires a personal guarantee, a principal's personal guarantee is on file. Otherwise it is declined; a lower tier is never substituted on the same application.

On approval Commercial Credit assigns a credit line between the tier's lowest and highest credit line, within the business's relationship exposure cap. The entry figures, the credit line range and the guarantee requirement of each tier are those of the tier schedule.

Approval and decline are Commercial Credit decisions recorded by the system. Customer Care may submit an application but never decides one.

## Decision table

| Years, score and revenue each at or above the tier's figure | Tier requires a personal guarantee | Guarantee on file | Decision |
|---|---|---|---|
| Yes | No | Either | Approved |
| Yes | Yes | Yes | Approved |
| Yes | Yes | No | Declined |
| No (any one figure short) | Either | Either | Declined |

## Lifecycle of an application

An application is held as an account in applied status until Commercial Credit decides. Approval opens the account in active status with its assigned line and account number; a decline closes the application in declined status on the date of the decline.

## Hypothetical cases

- A business applies for the Commercial Account Net 30 Select with 3 years in business, a score of 75 and revenue of 750000.00, no guarantee on file. Every figure is met at the boundary and the tier does not require a guarantee: approved.
- The same business applies instead for the Commercial Account Net 45, whose figures it does not meet: declined; it is not approved for the Net 30 Select on that application.
- A business meeting every figure of the Pro Revolving Charge applies without a principal's guarantee on file: the tier requires one, so the application is declined.
